Manuscript section "Efficacy is robust across conspiracy themes and shifting conversational sentiment": the distribution of
participants' stated election claims by theme (GPT-coded, `02a_llm_theme_coding.R`), condition effects within each theme, and
sentiment across conversation rounds. Produces `figures/fig-themes.png` and the supplement's sentiment figure.

# Set Up

```{r packages & wd, include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
options(scipen=1, digits=3)

local({
  if (!file.exists(".here") && !file.exists("../.here")) {
    p <- tryCatch(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path, error = function(e) "")
    if (nzchar(p)) setwd(dirname(p))
  }
  here::i_am("scripts/06_results_themes.Rmd")
})

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())  # relative paths (data/, results/, figures/) resolve to 4-analysis/ when knitting
setwd(here::here())

source(here::here("R", "setup.R"))   # packages, data, reference levels, palettes, outcome vectors
report::report_system()

# 05_results_effects.Rmd compares conditions with Control as the reference and Study as a factor; the sentiment models
# below were fit in that state
df_both$ConditionFeedback <- relevel(df_both$ConditionFeedback, ref = "Control")
df_both$Study <- as.factor(df_both$Study)
```

# Claim themes

### Figure: Claim themes and effects by theme (`fig-themes`)

```{r ellemr themes summary, fig.height=6, fig.width=14, warning=FALSE}

df_convos <- df_convos %>% 
  mutate(ConspiracyTheme_Main = if_else(ConspiracyTheme_Main == "Gibberish or Irrelevant", "Unrelated",ConspiracyTheme_Main)) 

fig.themes <- df_convos %>% 
  #filter(ConspiracyTheme_Main != "Unrelated" & ConspiracyTheme_Main != "Other") %>%
  group_by(ConspiracyTheme_Main) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ConspiracyTheme_Main, percentage), y = percentage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#080E5B", color = NA) +  # Use stat="identity" to plot percentages
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 2), "% (n=", count, ")")), hjust = -0.1, size = 4) + 
  labs(x = "Conspiracy Type", y = "% of Total", title = "a) Election conspiracy themes") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  theme_classic() + 
  coord_flip()
#fig.themes


df_themeeff_long <- df_convos %>%
  filter(ConspiracyTheme_Main != "Unrelated" & ConspiracyTheme_Main != "Other") %>%
  dplyr::rename("2020 Denialism" = ER0_Diff,
                "Claim Certainty" = Sureness_Diff) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c("2020 Denialism", "Claim Certainty"),
    names_to = "Outcome",
    values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(ConspiracyTheme_Main = forcats::fct_infreq(ConspiracyTheme_Main))


fig.themeeffa <- ggplot(df_themeeff_long, aes(x = ConditionFeedback, y = Value, color = Outcome)) +
  #geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.5), alpha = 0.1) +
  stat_summary( fun.data = ggplot2::mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3,position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~ ConspiracyTheme_Main, nrow = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "darkgray", alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  #stat_compare_means(ref.group = "Control", hide.ns = TRUE, label = "p.signif", na.rm = TRUE, label.y = 15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2020 Denialism" = "#0B1B66", "Claim Certainty" = "#20A49C")) +
  labs(x = "Condition - Feedback Type", y = "Outcome Change", color = "Denialism Outcome", title = "b) AI conversation effects by condition") +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_flip() #+
  #ylim(c(-8,8))
#fig.themeeffa


sort(table(df_convos$ConspiracyTheme_Main))
prop.table(table(df_both$EmotionalTone))*100
prop.table(table(df_both$TypeOfThreat))*100
prop.table(table(df_both$TargetOfThreat))*100


report(chisq.test(table(df_convos$ConspiracyTheme_Main, df_convos$ER0_Diff)))
report(chisq.test(table(df_convos$ConspiracyTheme_Main, df_convos$Sureness_Diff)))

```

```{r merged themes fig, fig.height=16, fig.width=14, warning=FALSE}

fig_themes <- (
  (fig.themes / fig.themeeffa) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
) & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig_themes

ggsave("figures/fig-themes.png", fig_themes, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 600,create.dir = TRUE)


```

# Sentiment

```{r sentiment analysis}

#first 3 rows show initial responses to conspirsolicitat + expounding, row 3 is repeat of row 1 (dropped from seniment analysis)
#user response 1 = conspirsolicitat + expounding merged (fed to gpt)
#gpt response 1 = initial response to that
#user response 3 = 1305 vs res 4 = 764 (only in chat conditions), not all users had to provide a 3rd response, 
# Reshape data from wide to long format
df_long <- df_both %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("userResponse") | starts_with("GPTResponse"),
    names_to = c("Speaker", "Round"),
    names_pattern = "(user|GPT)Response_(\\d)",
    values_to = "ResponseText") %>%
  mutate(Round = as.numeric(Round),
         Speaker = factor(Speaker, levels = c("user", "GPT"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Round < 5, 
                !(is.na(Round)))

df_long$ConvoWords <- str_count(df_long$ResponseText, "\\w+")
summary(df_long$ConvoWords)

df_long %>%
  dplyr::summarize(ConvoTime = mean(ConvoTime,na.rm = T),
                   ConvoWords = mean(ConvoWords,na.rm = T))

df_long %>%
   group_by(ConditionFeedback) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(ConvoTime = mean(ConvoTime,na.rm = T),
                   ConvoWords = mean(ConvoWords,na.rm = T))

df_long %>%
   group_by(Speaker) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(ConvoTime = mean(ConvoTime,na.rm = T),
                   ConvoWords = mean(ConvoWords,na.rm = T))


df_long %>%
   group_by(Speaker,Round) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(ConvoTime = mean(ConvoTime,na.rm = T),
                   ConvoWords = mean(ConvoWords,na.rm = T))

table(df_long$Round)


# Use get_sentences to split text into sentences
df_long$Sentences <- get_sentences(df_long$ResponseText)

# Perform sentiment analysis on the processed sentences
sentiment_scores <- sentiment_by(df_long$Sentences)

# Add the sentiment scores
df_long$SentimentScore <- sentiment_scores$ave_sentiment
summary(df_long$SentimentScore)

       
table(df_long$Speaker,useNA = "always")


library(lme4); library(lmerTest); library(emmeans)

df_user <- df_long %>%
  filter(Speaker == "user", !is.na(SentimentScore)) %>%
  mutate(Round_c = Round - 1,                 # 0 = participant's initial claim
         AbsSent = abs(SentimentScore))       # distance from neutral

# 1. Does sentiment change across rounds, and does that differ by condition?
m_sent <- lmer(SentimentScore ~ Round_c * ConditionFeedback + Study + (1 | ResponseId),
               data = df_user)
summary(m_sent)
anova(m_sent)                                 # omnibus Round x Condition test

# 2. "Moving toward neutrality" = shrinking absolute sentiment
m_abs <- lmer(AbsSent ~ Round_c * ConditionFeedback + Study + (1 | ResponseId), data = df_user)
summary(m_abs)
# Slopes per condition
emtrends(m_sent, ~ ConditionFeedback, var = "Round_c", infer = TRUE)


interactions::interact_plot(m_sent, pred = Round_c, modx = ConditionFeedback, plot.points = FALSE, interval = TRUE,
                    x.label = "Round of Conversation", y.label = "Sentiment Score", legend.main = "Condition",
                    colors = condition_colors[levels(df_user$ConditionFeedback)]) +
  theme_classic()

summary(df_user$SentimentScore)


```

## Supplement figure: sentiment across rounds (`fig-sentiment`)

```{r sentiment plot, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE}
  #supplement fig
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.2)

fig_sentiment <- ggplot(df_long %>% filter(!(is.na(ConditionFeedback)) & !(is.na(Speaker))) ,
                        aes(x = Round, y = SentimentScore, group = interaction(ResponseId, Speaker), color = Speaker)) +
  # Plot individual sentiment trajectories with transparency
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "darkgray", alpha = 1, size = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.03, aes(group = interaction(ResponseId, Speaker)), position = pd) + #background jittered lines
  stat_summary(aes(group = Speaker), fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1, position = pd) +   # line connecting dots
  
  # Plot mean and standard deviation with error bars, dodged
  stat_summary(aes(group = Speaker), 
               fun.data = function(x) { 
                 data.frame(
                   y = mean(x),
                   ymin = mean(x) - sd(x),
                   ymax = mean(x) + sd(x) )}, 
               geom = "errorbar", width = 0.1, position = pd) +
  # Plot mean points, dodged
  stat_summary(aes(group = Speaker, fill = Speaker), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, shape = 21, position = pd) + #circles
  
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("user" = "#080E5B", "GPT" = "#8CB6A9")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("user" = "#080E5B", "GPT" = "#8CB6A9")) +
  labs(title = "Sentiment Scores Across Rounds of Conversation",
    x = "Round",
    y = "Sentiment Score",
    color = "Speaker") +
  # Apply a clean theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right") +
  facet_wrap(~ConditionFeedback, scales = "fixed", ncol = 4)
fig_sentiment

ggsave("figures/supplement/fig-sentiment.png", fig_sentiment, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, create.dir = TRUE)


```
